title: Cohomology commutes with completed principal reduction under injectivity
statement: For an adic principal datum d on a domain A, a nonzero generator π, and a completed-coefficient derived object K, injectivity of π on H^(q+1)(K) makes the canonical map Ext(H^q(K))→H^q(Ext K) an isomorphism for every finite quotient.

source.place: Order 1429, sufficient uniformizer-injectivity criterion; normalized principal quotient triangle (Stacks Tag 06YU).

proof.text: Use the completed short exact principal presentation from the lower-bound lemma construction. The constant unit and ordinary extension formulas identify the regular endomorphism on sections with multiplication by the image of π^(n+1).

Iterate the assumed injectivity to the relevant positive power. The tensor unit identifies its action on cohomology with scalar multiplication, hence makes that action monic. In the normalized quotient triangle cohomology sequence its kernel is zero. The short exact sequence identifies the restricted canonical cohomology comparison as an isomorphism. Exact restriction and faithful forgetting reflect isomorphisms, proving the stated comparison. This includes the empty scheme, vanishing cohomology, and n=0.

    (T : Scheme.{u}) {A : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A] [IsDomain A]
    (d : AdicCoefficientDatum A) (π : A) (hI : d.ideal = Ideal.span {π})
    (hπ : π ≠ 0) (n : ℕ) (K : PbcCompletedDerived T d) (q : ℤ)
    (hinj : ∀ U : T.ProEtᵒᵖ,
      Function.Injective (fun x :
        ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ (q + 1)).obj K).val.obj U ↦
        (CompletedConstantReduction.base T d.ideal ≫
          CompletedConstantReduction.completedComparison T d.ideal d.quotientFinite).hom.app U
            ((adicLisseConstantUnit T A).app U π) • x)) :
    IsIso (((pbcScalarAdjunction (pbcAdicProjection T d n)).homEquiv _ _).symm
      ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).map
          ((pbcDerivedScalarAdjunction (pbcAdicProjection T d n)).unit.app K) ≫
        ((pbcRestrict (pbcAdicProjection T d n)).mapDerivedCategoryHomologyFunctorIso q).inv.app
          ((pbcDerivedExtend (pbcAdicProjection T d n)).obj K)))
